title: Data and code for Service-Preserving Generative Moving Target Defense for Web Applications
description: Version 2 of the standalone study data companion. Adds prospectively registered MiniShop model/arm comparisons, bounded Juice Shop fixed-public-route generation, interrupted prospective attack records, a separate historical-case informed replay, and a Flaskr response-timing reinterpretation. The Juice Shop generated layer covers two edge operations, not the full application. Includes failed and rejected calls and limits; excludes raw auth tokens, provider transcripts, and third-party application source.
